name: Sentinel Onaeya
summary: Sentinel Onaeya is a night elf guardian stationed at Maestra's Post in northwestern Ashenvale, near the border with Darkshore. Tasked with holding the line against encroaching perils, she rallies capable Alliance adventurers to safeguard the forest and aid fellow sentinels.

sections.title: A Guard on the Frontier
sections.body: Maestra's Post serves as a critical wayside outpost along the road from Darkshore into the dense, contested canopy of Ashenvale. Sentinel Onaeya stands guard outside the settlement's main lodge, keeping a vigilant watch over travelers and coordinating defensive actions. Between hostile wildlife, corrupting forces, and border tensions, sentinels like Onaeya represent the first line of defense for night elf settlements in the region.

sections.title: Holding the Post
sections.body: Onaeya receives news of Sentinel Aynasha, who is attacked by furbolgs while carrying an important message through Darkshore. She rewards adventurers who protect the poisoned sentinel until her antidote takes effect.

faq.answer: Sentinel Onaeya is a night elf sentinel stationed at Maestra's Post in northwestern Ashenvale. She acts as a quest giver and frontline defender, directing travelers to assist the outpost.
She can be found standing just outside the main building at Maestra's Post, along the northern roadway in Ashenvale right below the border with Darkshore.

faq.q: What faction does Sentinel Onaeya belong to?
faq.answer: She is a member of the Night Elf Sentinels and is loyal to the Alliance. Horde adventurers will find her hostile on sight.

faq.q: How is Onaeya connected to Sentinel Aynasha?
faq.answer: Sentinel Aynasha asks adventurers to report to Onaeya at Maestra's Post after they protect her from attacking furbolgs. Onaeya rewards their bravery and is glad to hear Aynasha survived.

faq.q: What kind of tasks does Sentinel Onaeya give?
faq.answer: Onaeya rewards adventurers who protect Sentinel Aynasha from attacking furbolgs in Darkshore and bring word of her safety to Maestra's Post.

faq.q: Why is Maestra's Post important to the Sentinels?
faq.answer: Maestra's Post acts as a crucial checkpoint connecting Darkshore's supply routes to the heart of Ashenvale. Holding it prevents hostile incursions from cutting off night elf travelers moving south.

angles.text: For night elves traveling south from Darkshore, Onaeya represents the front line defending sacred Ashenvale woodland from external threats.
Onaeya coordinates essential defensive tasks for Alliance travelers transitioning from the coastal wilds into the contested forests of Ashenvale.
As a dedicated sentinel holding Maestra's Post, Onaeya is an active enemy combatant guarding the northern approaches into Ashenvale.
